rule.name: append-only
rule.description: Only append new content to .md and .data files; never overwrite existing content.

rule.name: refine
rule.description: Refine existing content by appending updated sections with timestamps, preserving all prior content.

rule.name: no-overwrite
rule.description: Documents must never be truncated or overwritten. All writes are additive.

strategy.name: fibonacci
strategy.description: Basic link extraction. Scans only top-level href/src attributes for direct file links. Minimal parsing, fastest execution.

strategy.name: galileo
strategy.description: Observational parsing. Extracts links from the full DOM including nested elements. Identifies file type by content-type headers.

strategy.name: davinci
strategy.description: Multi-faceted analysis. Parses HTML structure, follows redirects through intermediate pages, inspects embedded media tags and data attributes.

strategy.name: marconi
strategy.description: Signal-tracing approach. Follows all link chains aggressively, resolves shortened URLs, decodes encoded parameters to uncover hidden file references.

strategy.name: fermi
strategy.description: Exhaustive deep analysis. Maximum crawl depth, parses JavaScript for dynamically generated links, inspects all response headers, follows every discoverable path.
